title: RunAnywhere AI Launches Wally Catalog With 10 Unified Open Models
summary:
The release of seven new open models by RunAnywhere AI now allows developers to access a wider variety of large language models through a unified interface. This expansion introduces the Wally model catalog, which aggregates 10 different engines—including MiniMax M3, GLM-5.3 (Fast), Kimi K3, and four variants of DeepSeek V4—under a single API key.

Y Combinator publicized the update to its network, highlighting the streamlined access to these a-priori disparate models. The current catalog of 10 engines is likely to grow shortly, with Andrew Curran indicating that the Kimi K3.1 model is about to be released.
